title: D5-K10 — Frozen Extended Validation Protocol for ERP CORE N170
principle: Predefine extension design and analytical decisions before inspecting new participants' condition contrasts; pilot is exploratory and remains frozen.
research_question: Does the digitally verified author LCD-event correction change N170 face-minus-car mean-amplitude inference in an extended ERP CORE cohort, and which conclusions retain their sign under prespecified temporal-uncertainty operators?

data_scope.source: ERP CORE N170 original/shifted EEGLAB OSF sources; NEMAR/BIDS where available
data_scope.extended_target: All discoverable, accessible, technically eligible distinct ERP CORE N170 participants outside the three-person pilot; up to approximately 40 source participants if accessible, not assumed available, mapped or eligible.
data_scope.candidate_discovery: Inventory OSF/NEMAR participant IDs and metadata only; verify identity and marker mapping before processing; record all exclusions and reasons before inspecting outcomes.
data_scope.operational_go_no_go_target: Aim for at least 20 new eligible independent participants to support a meaningful extended group analysis; NOT a statistical power guarantee. If fewer, label exploratory and do not issue a confirmatory claim.
data_scope.holdout_rule: No new-subject ERP contrast inspection or data-driven changes to inclusion rules before the D5-K10 freeze and cohort manifest. All new subjects processed by the same frozen analysis.

digital_provenance.baseline: NEMAR sub-001/002/003 markers match original OSF; exactly 26 integer stimulus samples added in source-shifted files at 1024 Hz; 964 responses unshifted
digital_provenance.extended_gate: Never assume offset on unseen participants. Check sampling rate, full event-code ordering, response marker alignment, and per-stimulus source shift. Use +26 discrete samples ONLY when independently verified for that participant; otherwise quarantine and document.

pilot_authorities: D5-K6F8 frozen A/B output and underlying pre-artifact behavioral event identities
D5-K7A–E frozen hypothetical measurement-window uncertainty experiments (not measured hardware jitter)
D5-K8G and D5-K8I-R1 frozen OSF vs NEMAR per-event provenance
D5-K9 frozen paired original/LCD-referenced pilot analysis, including 12 comparison rows and 98,400 waveform rows
frozen_analysis.units: Person for group-level inference; trial for estimation within person
frozen_analysis.reference_original: Digital stored original EEG stimulus marker
frozen_analysis.reference_lcd: Source-verified discrete event shift (pilot +26 samples), independently re-epoch and re-baseline; NOT direct physical-onset verification
frozen_analysis.contrast: Face minus car mean-amplitude ERP contrast, not peak latency
frozen_analysis.primary_arm: A: all condition-identifiable stimulus epochs prior to EEG artifact rejection
frozen_analysis.behavioral_sensitivity_arm: B: eligible trials under frozen exact-rule D5-K6A/F8 (one correct response, RT 200–1000ms inclusive); requires source-compatible behavioral fields and event match; report unavailable when not implementable rather than substituting a rule
frozen_analysis.filter: Continuous EEG 0.1–30 Hz, Butterworth IIR order 2, zero phase, EEG channels
frozen_analysis.reference: Average of all EEG channels in subject; prior to epoching
frozen_analysis.branch_order: Verify timing identity → filter/re-reference continuous data once → independent original vs corrected epochs → separate baselines → same matched trial identities → ERP condition means and paired contrasts
frozen_analysis.qc_policy: Produce blinded QC diagnostics (bad channels, EOG, epoch amplitude, missingness, event consistency); no artifact cleaning until a separate predeclared approved amendment. Uncleaned estimates are methodological sensitivity results, not certified physiological effects.
frozen_analysis.primary_endpoint: Within-subject delta_uV = (corrected - original) face-minus-car mean in 110–150 ms at PO8, Arm A; evaluate only extended held-out participants.
secondary_endpoints: Within-subject change of sign (descriptive, no causal claim)
PO8 Arm B when complete compatible behavioral metadata available (sensitivity)
PO7 Arm A/B as secondary channels
ERP waveform and QC descriptive outputs
Conditional robustness under prespecified hypothetical finite postprocessing window perturbations, clearly separate from physical timing correction
frozen_analysis.inferential_rule: Two-sided participant-level mean delta and 95% participant-resampling bootstrap CI with fixed seed 20261019 and 10000 bootstrap replicates; report sign-flip counts descriptive. If <20 held-out eligible, descriptive only. Primary endpoint only; secondary endpoints remain descriptive unless a prospective multiplicity plan amendment precedes new outcomes.
frozen_analysis.sample_size_warning: Operational n>=20 threshold is not a power analysis; formally justify n with a separate power/precision assessment before claiming adequately powered confirmatory study.
frozen_analysis.statistical_scope: Participants are independent units, multiple trials/channels/arms are not independent persons; no clinical, cognitive or causal inference.

implementation_stages.name: Offline source audit and protocol freeze
implementation_stages.entry: Frozen pilot D5K6F8/K8G/K8I-R1/K9 outputs and read-only protocol
implementation_stages.go: Hashes all valid; pilot 1924 events, 960 stimuli shifted, 964 responses unchanged, 12 contrasts, 3 sign changes
implementation_stages.no_go: Tampering, missing manifest, inconsistent count, protocol changed after freeze
implementation_stages.implementation: Included stdlib Python preflight; does not analyze extended EEG

implementation_stages.name: Extended participant inventory
implementation_stages.entry: OSF/NEMAR metadata and confirmed terms of use
implementation_stages.go: Candidate census, accessible EEG/events/source pairs, unique mapping, missingness and exclusion reasons
implementation_stages.implementation: Separate validated inventory/ingestion component; NOT included in Stage 0

implementation_stages.name: Cohort manifest lock
implementation_stages.go: All candidates labeled included/excluded with prespecified eligibility, immutable IDs and source hashes
implementation_stages.no_go: Selection based on contrast size/sign or hidden outcome inspection
implementation_stages.implementation: Separate cohort locker; freeze BEFORE D5-K10 outcome processing

implementation_stages.name: Event provenance and LCD validation
implementation_stages.entry: Original and shifted EEGLAB / matching BIDS per subject
implementation_stages.go: Event codes and latencies verified; exact participant offset documented; responses unchanged when applicable
implementation_stages.no_go: Unresolved subject mapping or temporal transformation
implementation_stages.implementation: Extend tested D5K8G/K8I-R1 modules after code review

implementation_stages.name: Paired EEG processing and QC
implementation_stages.go: Original vs correction branches matched trial-by-trial; frozen preprocessing; QC report; no unauthorized cleaning
implementation_stages.no_go: Broken provenance, sampling mismatch, failed reproducibility, disallowed artifact operations
implementation_stages.implementation: Refactor D5-K9 in separate audited release; no change to frozen D5-K9

implementation_stages.name: Group analysis and constrained sensitivity
implementation_stages.entry: Locked per-person primary estimates and QC
implementation_stages.go: Held-out-only participant-level effects/CI, multiplicity policy, descriptive sign results, source-aware sensitivity
implementation_stages.no_go: Treating trials as persons, posthoc cleaning, uncalibrated jitter labeled hardware

implementation_stages.name: Independent audit and evidence freeze
implementation_stages.go: Full SHA256SUMS, second implementation/checker, reproducibility across environments, figure data provenance, anonymization and IP gate review
implementation_stages.no_go: Hash mismatch, unresolved QC or claims exceeding evidence

technical: Pilot paired comparison exactly 12 rows / 3 sign flips
Every new subject has traceable source hashes and independent participant ID
scientific: No unsupported physical-onset or hardware-jitter claim

outcome_labels.HOLD: Missing evidence, limited n, unresolved QC or unavailable source; transparent restrictions
outcome_labels.STOP: Hashes altered, unapproved cleaning, selection on outcomes, invalid source mapping or disclosure gate violation

acceptance.manuscript_gate: Begin final manuscript drafting only after Stage K10-6 evidence lock (or explicitly downgrade to pilot methodological report with truthful limitations).

expected_artifacts: figure-source tables and draft multipanel figure plan

publication.target: Biomedical Signal Processing and Control (conditional on validation and editorial scope)
publication.working_title: Event-Marker Provenance and Inference Stability in EEG: A Reproducible Evaluation of LCD Delay Correction in ERP N170 Analysis
publication.figure_note: Do not imitate fMRI/connectivity images from the example presentation or assert MRI neuroimaging outcomes. Use actual EEG provenance and validated results.
publication.writing_rule: Draft final Results/Abstract after evidence lock; methods skeleton may be assembled internally beforehand, without public release.
